title: Pure Rebel Bots
summary: Pure Rebel Bots build combining the Boot-Up Dynamo series and classic Gadget monsters with Clockwork Night and Bot Herder. The strategy equips Gadget monsters from the hand and GY to swarm the field for Rank 4 Xyz and Link plays while turning all monsters into Machines to steal opposing threats.

summary.title: Starters
points: Gold Gadget and Silver Gadget Special Summon a Level 4 Machine from the hand when Normal or Special Summoned, and summon another Gadget from the Deck if destroyed by battle or card effect.
Red Gadget, Green Gadget, and Yellow Gadget form a continuous search loop on summon, keeping the hand stocked with Level 4 Machine materials.
Boot-Up Corporal - Command Dynamo targets up to 2 Gadget monsters in the hand or GY, Special Summons itself from the hand, and equips those targets to itself as Equip Spells.

summary.title: Opening: Gold Gadget + Command Dynamo
steps: Normal Summon Gold Gadget and activate its effect to Special Summon Red Gadget from your hand, searching Yellow Gadget on summon.
Activate Boot-Up Corporal - Command Dynamo in hand, targeting a Gadget in hand or GY to equip it and summon itself.
Activate Boot-Up Order - Gear Charge to Special Summon your equipped Gadget monster to the Monster Zone as a monster.
Overlay two Level 4 Machines for Gear Gigant X to detach a material and search another Machine, or link them into Platinum Gadget or Clockwork Knight.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Boot-Up Admiral - Destroyer Dynamo summons itself from hand by sending 2 Gadget Monster Cards from your hand or field to the GY, cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects while you control a Gadget, and destroys 1 card on the field once per turn.
Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops uses used Xyz monsters as Link Material to field an unaffected 4000 ATK boss that revives Gear Gigant X and detaches an opposing card to attach it as material.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir stalls opposing monster effects by forcing all face-up monsters into Defense Position.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Clockwork Night turns all face-up monsters on the field into Machines, buffs your Machines by 500 ATK while debuffing the opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from the GY to search Destroyer Dynamo.
Bot Herder takes permanent control of an opposing face-up Machine monster, which Clockwork Night enables against any opponent's monster.
Boot-Up Order - Gear Charge summons equipped Gadget cards as monsters and discards a card once per turn to add Destroyer Dynamo from your Deck.

Boot-Up Order - Gear Force destroys opposing Attack Position monsters up to the number of Machines you control when an attack is declared, while Stronghold the Moving Fortress provides an extra Level 4 Machine body.

allow.Clockwork Night: Continuous Spell that turns ALL face-up monsters on the field into Machine-Type (allowing Bot Herder to permanently steal ANY monster your opponent controls!), boosts your Machine Rebel Bots by 500 ATK, weakens opponent's monsters by 500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Boot-Up Admiral - Destroyer Dynamo!
allow.Gear Gigant X: Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz (2 Level 4 Machine monsters) that detaches 1 material to search any Level 4 or lower Machine from your Deck or GY.
allow.Clockwork Knight: Link-1 EARTH Machine that sends a Continuous Spell to search Clockwork Night, and tributes a Machine to revive a Level 4 EARTH Machine from your GY.
allow.Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired T: Rank 4 Xyz made with any two Level 4 Gadgets or Command Dynamo.
allow.Infinitrack Fortress Megaclops: Link-3 EARTH Machine boss that is unaffected by non-Xyz monster effects and revives Gear Gigant X to destroy an opponent's card.
allow.R.B. Shepherd's Crook: R.B. Shepherd's Crook: Endboard boss featured on page analysis.

main: Boot-Up Corporal - Command Dynamo
Core Level 4 EARTH Machine extender: targets up to 2 Machine 'Gadget' monsters in your hand/GY, Special Summons itself from hand, and equips those targets to itself!
Boot-Up Admiral - Destroyer Dynamo

Signature Level 8 EARTH Machine boss (2500 ATK): Special Summoned from hand by sending 2 'Gadget' Monster Cards from hand/field to GY; cannot be destroyed while you control a 'Gadget', and destroys 1 card on field once per turn!
Boot-Up Soldier - Dread Dynamo
Level 4 EARTH Machine (2000 DEF) that gains 1600 ATK (to 2000 ATK) while you control a 'Gadget' monster.
Gold Gadget
Level 4 LIGHT Machine: when Normal or Special Summoned, Special Summons 1 Level 4 Machine from hand; when destroyed, summons a Level 4 Gadget from Deck.
Silver Gadget
Level 4 LIGHT Machine: when Normal or Special Summoned, Special Summons 1 Level 4 Machine from hand; when destroyed, summons a Level 4 Gadget from Deck.
Green Gadget
Level 4 EARTH Machine: when Normal or Special Summoned, adds 1 'Red Gadget' from your Deck to your hand.
Red Gadget
Level 4 EARTH Machine: when Normal or Special Summoned, adds 1 'Yellow Gadget' from your Deck to your hand.
Yellow Gadget
Level 4 EARTH Machine: when Normal or Special Summoned, adds 1 'Green Gadget' from your Deck to your hand.
Boot-Up Order - Gear Charge
Signature Continuous Spell: targets any number of equipped 'Gadget' Monster Cards you control and Special Summons them, and discards 1 card once per turn to search Destroyer Dynamo!
Clockwork Night
Turns all monsters on the field into Machine-Type (enabling Bot Herder to steal any monster!), gives Machines +500 ATK, and banishes from GY to search Destroyer Dynamo.
Boot-Up Order - Gear Force
Normal Trap: when a monster declares an attack, destroys Attack Position monsters your opponent controls up to the number of Machine monsters you control!
Stronghold the Moving Fortress
Continuous Trap Monster: Special Summons itself as a Level 4 EARTH Machine (0 ATK / 2000 DEF), and gains 2000 ATK if you control Green, Red, and Yellow Gadget.
Bot Herder
Normal Trap: targets 1 face-up Machine monster your opponent controls; takes permanent control of it, and if destroyed by battle, burns your opponent for its original ATK!
extra: Signature Link-2 LIGHT Machine: once per turn Special Summons 1 Level 4 or lower Machine from hand; when destroyed, summons a Level 4 'Gadget' from Deck!
Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz: detaches 1 material to add ANY Level 4 or lower Machine monster from your Deck or GY to your hand.
Link-1 EARTH Machine: sends a Continuous Spell to search Clockwork Night, and tributes a Machine to revive a Level 4 EARTH Machine Gadget from GY.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 Xyz made with any two Level 4 Gadgets.
Link-3 EARTH Machine boss summoned using your used Rank 4 Xyz monsters.
